title: Summoning the egg in daylight after leaving the program

tellings.quote: Behind that, the egg flies by um in dead silence, makes a turn and comes around in to land and disappears behind the house.

plain: In 2024, after leaving the secret programme he says he worked for, a former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says he called up "the egg", an egg-shaped craft, in daylight in the desert, and it "flies by in dead silence, makes a turn and comes around in to land and disappears behind the house." Barber tells Michels he was there and names the Stanford scientist Garry Nolan as a witness. If true, it would mean such a craft can be summoned on purpose.
